TEMPORARY RESTRICTED AREA IN THE VICINITY OF COUNTIES DUBLIN, 
WICKLOW, KILDARE, AND MEATH FROM WEDNESDAY 11TH NOVEMBER TO SATURDAY 
14TH NOVEMBER 2026.

TEMPORARY RESTRICTIONS (TEMPORARY RESTRICTED AREAS) ON THE FLYING OF 
AIRCRAFT AND ROCKETS AS DEFINED IN S.I. NO. 25 OF 2023, SHALL APPLY 
IN THE GREATER DUBLIN AREA IN THE AIRSPACE CONTAINED WITHIN THE 
UNDER MENTIONED:

LATERAL LIMITS:
534100.00N 0063500.00W, 534100.00N 0053000.00W,
530900.00N 0053000.00W, 530900.00N 0064500.00W,
532500.00N 0064500.00W, 532500.00N 0063500.00W,
534100.00N 0063500.00W

VERTICAL LIMITS: SFC/FL100

DURATION: THE PERIOD OF THE RESTRICTION SHALL BE FROM 0900 HR UTC 
WEDNESDAY 11TH NOVEMBER TO 1200 HR UTC SATURDAY 14TH NOVEMBER.

STATE AIRCRAFT, AIRCRAFT OF THE IRISH COASTGUARD SERVICE AND HEMS 
AIRCRAFT OPERATORS EMPLOYED ON AN OPERATIONAL MISSION SHALL BE 
EXEMPT FROM THE RESTRICTION INCLUDING FLIGHTS AUTHORISED BY THE 
CONTROLLING AUTHORITY (DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE).
ALL SCHEDULED COMMERCIAL ARRIVALS AND DEPARTURES AT DUBLIN AIRPORT 
ARE EXEMPT.
ALL SCHEDULED COMMERCIAL ARRIVALS AND DEPARTURES, SAR AT WESTON 
AIRPORT ARE EXEMPT.
FOCAL POINT FOR THE CONTROLLING AUTHORITY: DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE, 
COFLIGHTS (AT) JUSTICE.IE
